observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with white walls, light wood floor, a dark ceiling with track lighting, a wall-mounted air-conditioning unit at upper left, and a full-height mirror covering the right wall. A single female dancer with long dark hair, a black sleeveless top, a black pleated mini-skirt and black thigh-high boots stands facing the mirror, so her back is to the camera while her front is seen as a mirror reflection (the 'second figure' facing us is her reflection, not a separate person). The camera and background remain fixed throughout.
visible_changes: The dancer's mirror-side arm moves through a sequence: it extends outward toward the mirror (t~0.12-0.20), then bends upward near the shoulder/head (t~0.24-0.36), then lowers again.
Her long hair swings sharply to one side with visible motion blur around t~0.44-0.64, settles, and swings again briefly around t~1.08-1.24, indicating head/torso movement.
The torso and hips rotate and the leg stance shifts slightly over the clip, ending in a wider, more angled posture.
In the later portion (t~1.9 onward, i.e. frames from ~0.76s), the reflection shows a hand raised near the face/mouth while the back view shows the corresponding arm bent forward.
The mirror reflection reproduces every movement of the dancer in real time (arm, hair, body orientation), confirming it is a reflection rather than an independent object.
Background elements (AC unit, ceiling lights, mirror seams, floor) stay in identical positions, indicating no camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether these movements are part of a longer choreographed routine and what precedes or follows the cropped segment.
The music/tempo or intent driving the gestures.
Any movement of the dancer before t=0 or after the final frame.
uncertain_details: Exact hand gestures and finger positions are hard to resolve due to distance and motion blur.
The precise axis of body rotation (whether driven by hips, shoulders or head) cannot be definitively separated from the hair swing.
